summary.headline: Near-term VIX remains range/carry driven while November concentrates the real event hedge at 20 and 24-25.
key_points: Headline +$52.3M VIX delta is not a front panic signal: August and September positive delta is largely created by sold puts.
September remains a short-range book around 18-20 with call supply at 20-23.
October incremental flow is strongly short VIX around 19-24.
November is the main defensive bucket: long movement around 20 plus repeated 24-25 call demand.
The Sep-23 50P/100P deep-ITM vertical is nearly delta-neutral and treated as financing/relative-value.
summary.daily_note: Рабочий режим: ближайший риск остаётся контролируемым, а реальная покупка выпуклости сосредоточена в ноябре. Для SPX среда остаётся поддерживающей, пока сентябрьский VIX не принимает 18-20; выше 20-23 включается маршрут к 24-25.

leave_one_out.comment: Largest single trade is November 20C buy. Removing it keeps the day positive VIX delta. Removing the full 16:49 November package leaves about +$29.8M VIX delta.

special_adjustments.comment: Sep-23 50P/100P vertical inflates premium but is nearly delta-neutral and is excluded from directional regime interpretation.

levels.label: 15-17 FRONT VIX FLOOR / PUT RISK ACCEPTANCE
levels.interpretation: Heavy August and September put selling accepts low-VIX downside and makes 15-17 the main front floor zone.

notes: Front positive VIX delta is largely sold-put driven, not call chasing.

levels.label: 18-20 NEAR/MID VIX PIVOT
levels.interpretation: September and October synthetics, short-range books and overwrites cluster here. Acceptance above this band is the first meaningful stress switch.

levels.label: 21-23 NEAR STRESS SUPPLY
levels.interpretation: September calls are predominantly sold in 21-23, making this the first supply band above the near-term pivot.

levels.label: 24-25 NOVEMBER EVENT/STRESS DEMAND
levels.interpretation: Repeated November 24C/25C buying on top of movement around 20 makes 24-25 the strongest active deferred stress zone.

levels.label: 29-30 FIRST MONETIZATION / CAP
levels.interpretation: 29-30 is the next likely monetization band after 24-25, though current-day premium is much smaller.

notes: Role uses current flow plus the stateful VIX book.

levels.label: 50 NOVEMBER DISASTER INSURANCE
levels.interpretation: November 50C is a deferred disaster-insurance layer, not a normal VIX target.

events: Sep/Oct short-VIX package offsets part of deferred hedge
Flow becomes near-neutral after the main morning structures
Late flow returns to premium selling while VIX stays near session lows

structures.interpretation: Repeated deep-ITM 50P/100P verticals are nearly delta-neutral and treated as financing/relative-value rather than directional VIX risk.
Likely long November 20 straddle plus a large 25C overlay; buys movement around the forward and additional upside stress convexity.
Short 20 body with a larger 24C purchase shifts exposure toward moderate November stress while monetizing central volatility.
Paired September and October synthetic-short-like legs with 23C/24C overwrites express normalization in the near/mid curve and cap moderate stress.
August 19P demand is financed by lower put sales while September lower puts are sold, reinforcing a low-VIX floor and normalization profile.

monetization_zones.description: Front put risk is repeatedly accepted in 15-17, favoring decay/range while VIX remains above the lower sold-put wing.
monetization_zones.caveat: If these are closing long puts rather than opening sales, the floor interpretation weakens.

monetization_zones.description: 18-20 is the main near/mid body monetization zone while the curve remains in contango.
monetization_zones.caveat: Acceptance above 20 with new call buying would invalidate simple decay.

monetization_zones.description: 24-25 is the first materially purchased deferred stress-realization zone.
monetization_zones.caveat: The multileg packages are inferred and opening status is unknown.

levels.label: SEP 26 SELECTIVE CONVEXITY
